# Foothold Technology

> > Foothold Technology provides AWARDS and other human services software solutions for case management, data collection, and reporting for nonprofit and government organizations.

Foothold Technology specializes in cloud-based software platforms designed to help human services organizations manage client data, streamline workflows, and meet regulatory compliance requirements. Their flagship product AWARDS serves agencies across behavioral health, developmental disabilities, child welfare, and other social service sectors.
